evidence.note: Claim: `bug fixed --landed` crashes because verify_regression_test calls run_command_gate without cfg, so run_command_gate falls back to Config.load(cwd) on a scratch worktree checking out a historical commit whose committed .ddflow/config.toml holds base_ref="--local" (the leaked flag), which Config.check refuses. REFUTED-by-fix: passing cfg=cfg through verify_regression_test and verify_test_only_fix removes the reload; regression test test_a_landing_whose_committed_config_is_invalid_uses_the_callers_config raised InvalidValue before the fix (FAILED, InvalidValue: invalid worktree.base_ref="--local") and passes after. Confirmed: git log -S showed 013975596 committed base_ref="--local", removed by 3c834a8fb; the parent of the landing sha still carries it.

Rules followed: claim-before-edit (leased fix-B20cfd41344), regression test written first and shown to fail on unfixed code, cross-family review planned, no companion installed unasked, no raw full-suite pytest (only the change-reached selection). r-consent-outward/r-alert-owner respected.

Changed ddflow/services/gates/mutation.py (run_command_gate(run, tree, cfg=cfg) and run_command_gate(pre_run, ptree, cfg=cfg)) and ddflow/services/gates/regression_testfix.py (two run_command_gate(run, ptree, cfg=cfg)); added tests/test_bug_fixed_landed.py::test_a_landing_whose_committed_config_is_invalid_uses_the_callers_config. 31 tests pass (test_bug_fixed_landed, test_regression_testfix_landed, test_regression_prefix_base, test_regression_testfix).

chunk_findings.detail: The patch prevents `run_command_gate` itself from reloading the scratch tree’s committed config, but in the pre-fix branch `pre_command` is still taken from `ptree`’s committed config just before the patched call at line 404 (the adjacent comment says pre_command can differ from the fixed-tree command because it is read from the pre-fix tree’s config). Given `ddflow bug fixed <task> --landed <sha>` where the pre-fix parent commit also has the invalid `worktree.base_ref = "--local"` (the same class of committed config this change is meant to tolerate), that config load still raises `InvalidValue` before `run_command_gate(pre_run, ptree, cfg=cfg)` is reached. So the fix does not make the `--landed` flow safe for an invalid pre-fix committed config.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/gates/mutation.py:400 (pre-fix `pre_command` derivation)

chunk_findings.detail:
The regression setup injects the invalid `worktree.base_ref` by replacing the hard-coded exact string `[worktree]
enabled = true
` and never verifies the replacement happened. If `ddflow init` in the environment produces any other form, such as `[worktree]
enabled = false`, a different key order, or different line endings, the `str.replace` is a no-op. The landing commit then carries a valid committed config, `api.bug_fixed` never observes the crashing `base_ref = "--local"`, and the test can pass on the unfixed code, so it would fail to protect B20cfd41344. It should use a TOML parser/setter to place the invalid key, or at least assert that `base_ref = "--local"` is present before committing.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_bug_fixed_landed.py:_landed_with_invalid_committed_base_ref
